dish.title: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl
dish.name: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl
dish.description: Cold rinsed soba tossed with sesame oil, rice vinegar, and soy, topped with julienned carrot, edamame, and sesame seeds.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl
recipe_version.description: Cold rinsed soba tossed with sesame oil, rice vinegar, and soy, topped with julienned carrot, edamame, and sesame seeds.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Boiling water for the soba. The dressing is not cooked.
recipe_version.doneness: Soba is done when tender but not mushy, 4 to 5 minutes, then rinsed cold. Edamame is already cooked and only thawed.

ingredients.name: soba noodles
ingredients.note: Dry. Assume ordinary wheat-and-buckwheat soba, not 100 percent buckwheat and not egg soba. Egg soba would add egg and would drop the plant claim.

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.note: Same amount as v1. This is not citrus.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: Regular soy sauce. Wheat and soy. Not a gluten-free substitute.

ingredients.name: edamame
ingredients.note: Shelled. Thawed if frozen. Soy. Same amount as v1.

ingredients.name: sesame seeds
ingredients.note: v1 tops the bowl with sesame seeds and does not list them. Drafter amount. Not toasted, because v1 does not say toasted.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Boil the soba 4 to 5 minutes, until tender but not mushy. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool. This is not a 25-minute boil and it is not a broth soup.

steps.title: Dress
steps.body: Toss the cooled noodles with the sesame oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and julienned carrot.

steps.title: Top
steps.body: Top with the edamame and the sesame seeds. Do not add lime, cilantro, peanut, or another vegetable.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Plant and dairy-free for wheat-and-buckwheat soba with no egg. Egg soba would void plant and add egg. Not gluten-free. The legacy dietary tag bowl is a format, not a diet.
allergen_notes: Wheat from ordinary soba and from soy sauce. Soy from soy sauce and edamame. Sesame from sesame oil and sesame seeds.
No egg, milk, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish when the soba is the egg-free kind named above.
v1 allergens were an empty array.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: Sesame is not a nut. No peanut.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant ingredients. Wheat is allowed for HH001. No dairy, meat, poultry, finfish, shellfish, or nuts. Not kitchen-tested.

changes_from_v1: Sesame seeds are in the last step and in the title, and they were not an ingredient. v2 lists 1 tbsp, a drafter amount, untoasted.
Cook clock was 25 minutes inside a 40-minute total, and the chip said 25. A 25-minute boil would ruin soba. v2 boils 4 to 5 minutes. Prep 15 plus cook 10 equals 25.
Allergens were empty. Content has wheat, soy, and sesame.
vocabulary citrusy was dropped. There is no citrus. Rice vinegar is not citrus. No lime was added.
Doneness was null. v2 states tender but not mushy, then rinsed cold.
unchanged_from_v1: Title, Japanese cuisine, bowl format, 12 oz soba, 1 cup shelled edamame, 1 julienned carrot, 2 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, stovetop boil, cold rinse, and the toss-and-top order.
